items.title: Juxtaposing a Koszul-regular sequence with a sequence that is Koszul-regular modulo the ideal it generates
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma is the Koszul-regular counterpart of the gluing statement for H1-regular sequences, and its proof is a 23-line chain of equalities and quasi-isomorphisms. It identifies the Koszul complex of the juxtaposed sequence with the total complex of the tensor product of the two Koszul complexes, uses the hypothesis that the first sequence is Koszul-regular to replace the first factor by the quotient, identifies the result with the Koszul complex of the second sequence over that quotient, and finally uses the second regularity hypothesis to recognise it as a resolution of the quotient by all the elements. Each of the four steps is attributed to a named statement, and the chain is displayed in full.
